I am a content creator with a focus on quick and healthy cooking videos, posting regularly to 1.2M followers. I'd like to expand my business/reach in several ways in the near future. 

1) To continue growing online. 
2) To publish a cook book (I have been contacted by a literary agent, but I can't decide whether to go the traditional route or self publish. Any advice?)
3) Start a food blog with a mix of mostly indulgent recipes and travel stories from my trip to France.

Considering my current situation:
- I work 4 days a week, so can only create content in my spare time. 
- I recently adopted a child, so my time/energy is even more restricted at the moment.
- I have a limited budget.

Can you help me devise a concrete 3 year plan to reach my goals?
